features: 🎧 IMMERSIVE 40MM DRIVERS : Experience powerful and detailed audio with 40mm drivers designed to deliver boAt Signature Sound for music, videos, calls and entertainment.
🔋 UP TO 50 HOURS PLAYBACK : Enjoy extended listening with up to 50 hours of total playback, making Rockerz Vibe suitable for everyday entertainment and travel.
⚡ BLUETOOTH 5.4 CONNECTIVITY : Connect wirelessly with compatible smartphones, tablets, laptops and other Bluetooth-enabled devices using Bluetooth v5.4.
🎮 60MS LOW-LATENCY BEAST MODE : Activate BEAST Mode for approximately 60ms low latency, designed to provide a more responsive audio experience while gaming and watching content.
🎙️ ENx TECHNOLOGY & EASY CONTROLS : ENx technology helps deliver clearer voice communication, while easy-access controls allow convenient control of music, calls and other functions.
description: Take your everyday audio experience to the next level with the boAt Rockerz Vibe. Equipped with 40mm drivers, these wireless headphones deliver immersive audio with boAt Signature Sound. With up to 50 hours of playback, Rockerz Vibe is designed for long listening sessions. Bluetooth 5.4 provides convenient wireless connectivity, while the Type-C interface makes charging easy. For gaming and other content where responsiveness matters, BEAST Mode with 60ms low latency provides a more responsive audio experience. The headphones also feature ENx technology, easy-access controls and a foldable design for convenient everyday use and portability.
